_note: Map v5's hand-made landmarks (map/model/landmarks.ts; MAP_README.md, 'Landmarks'). Each: a glTF model in this folder (file; y up, metres, its base at y 0), anchored by the OSM id of the building it stands in for (osm: 'way/123' — that building hidden) or a lat/lon (the building there hidden), turned rotation degrees (clockwise seen from above), scaled scale, lifted lift m; box [width, height, depth] m makes it solid (a box collider round its anchor), else it's drawn only. enabled: false keeps an entry as an example only.
